blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–Far Eastern University held off Adamson University, 73-66, on Wednesday to snap its three-game losing streak in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Unlike in their season-opening loss to the Falcons where they blew a big lead in the fourth, the Tamaraws this time hung tough down the stretch to improve to a 5-4 card good for a three-way, third-place tie with La Salle and Ateneo. “It really showed in the first three quarters and a half how well we were focusing on our defensive side […]...
